title: fix(comments): unreact, resolve and own-comment delete answer on a kernel with no http.server
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9JpRoUZGqtwqMU5k7b4C58D)_

Fixes #36469

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 托管环境里的成员现在可以撤回自己的表情回应、标记评论已解决或重新打开、删除自己的评论;以前这三个操作在托管环境一律报“找不到接口”,自托管环境不变。
- 修的是评论协作这块的托管缺口,与之前已裁定的“托管环境缺少服务端入口”一类问题同一种修法。
- 出错时只影响这三个评论操作:没装审计插件的环境会明确提示缺什么,而不是“找不到”;改动可以直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

The cause is in objectstack, in two layers: `AuditPlugin` mounted the three comment doors only on the kernel's own `http.server`, and the runtime dispatcher had no domain for `/comments`. A hosted tenant kernel owns no socket and registers no `http.server`, so `DELETE /api/v1/comments/reactions/:id`, `PUT /api/v1/comments/:id/resolution` and `DELETE /api/v1/comments/:id` fell through the host's catch-all to `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`.

Shape: ruling A on #22438 (record 6079645593, applied to this member of the class; seat scope comment 7081381198). Three segments, one PR.

- **spec** (`packages/spec/src/contracts/comment-doors-service.ts`): new `ICommentDoorsService` with one OPTIONAL, transport-neutral member `handleCommentDoor(request: Request)` answering a promised `Response`, the shape `IWebhookService.handleRedeliver` and `IApprovalService.handleActionPage` already use. `ServiceSlotContracts` gains `comments: ICommentDoorsService`. No comment service contract existed, so this is the smallest new one. API surface and export-origin snapshots gain the one interface.
- **plugin-audit** (`comment-doors-member.ts`, `audit-plugin.ts`): `init()` registers the `comments` service. Its member runs the SAME two registrars (`registerCommentReactionRoutes`, `registerCommentDoorsRoutes`) over the same deps as the `http.server` mount, on a private `HonoHttpServer` that never listens, built on first request. The registrar body moved verbatim into a module-level `registerCommentDoors(http, ctx)` that both faces call; `mountCommentDoors` is otherwise unchanged, so the raw mount is byte-unchanged and nothing is mounted twice. The no-server branch now logs (info) that the doors are served on the `comments` service instead of warning that they are unmounted. New dependency: `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`.
- **runtime** (`domains/comments.ts`, registered in `http-dispatcher.ts`): a `/comments` segment domain for `PUT`/`DELETE` that claims exactly the three method and path shapes and forwards `context.request` with its body unread (env-scoped spellings are rewritten to the `/api/v1` wire path). Every other `/comments` shape keeps `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`. No slot, or a slot without the member: `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` naming `@objectstack/plugin-audit`. A consumed body or a throwing member: sanitised 500, logged. No auth-gate or membership-gate exemption. Route ledger: three `server-only` rows under domain `/comments`.
- **guards**: `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` declares `comments.ts` in `DISPATCHER_DOMAINS`; the dogfood authz matrix classifies the new ledger key (`comment-doors-session`); the live-mount parity boot pins the three rows as unexercised (that boot composes no `AuditPlugin`).

Overlap: PR #36399 also edits `audit-plugin.ts`. This diff stays in the imports, the `init()` slot registration, `mountCommentDoors` and the new `registerCommentDoors` helper, and touches none of that PR's regions.

Out of scope here (filed separately by the seat): the personal-views and attachments doors of the same class.

## Tests

All readings at head `6b916dcfc` unless noted (spec and runtime source unchanged after the noted sha).

- `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/hono-comment-doors.conformance.test.ts` (new, the dispatcher-only shape: `createHonoApp`, no `http.server`, real `AuditPlugin`, real ObjectQL over sqlite-wasm): **6/6 passed**. Covers unreact, resolve then reopen, own-comment delete (200, store follows), byte parity of the anonymous refusal and the refused body between the self-hosted mount and the hosted door, and a typed `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` per door with no `comments` service.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/comments.test.ts` (new) + `route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`: **26/26 passed** (at `2f6e249ad`).
- `@objectstack/plugin-audit` full suite: **109 files, 1794 tests passed** (at `2f6e249ad`).
- `@objectstack/spec` `comment-doors-service.test.ts` + `core-service-contracts.test.ts`: **12/12 passed**; spec `typecheck` (incl. `check:test-typecheck`) exit 0.
- dogfood `authz-conformance.test.ts` + `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts`: **70/70 passed**.
- typecheck exit 0: plugin-audit, runtime, http-conformance, dogfood.

<details><summary>Red before, green after (two ablations, both restored)</summary>

Both via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 to 0, blob changed, then restored: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty). Both subjects resolve to source (runtime tests import `../http-dispatcher.js`; http-conformance aliases `@objectstack/plugin-audit` to `src`), so no dist rebuild sits between mutation and reading.

1. Runtime domain registration removed from `http-dispatcher.ts`: `comments.test.ts` **10 failed / 3 passed** (the door shapes fall to the ordinary miss).
2. `ctx.registerService('comments', ...)` removed from `audit-plugin.ts`: conformance **4 failed / 2 passed**. Unreact, resolve and own-delete answer `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED ... no comments service is registered`, and byte parity breaks.

Not done: a conformance-level ablation of the runtime domain. That subject reaches the conformance test through `@objectstack/runtime`'s `dist/` and would need a locked rebuild per leg. The unit-level ablation (1) covers the domain.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `6b916dcfc` derived 135 families. All 135 ran locally; `--ran` reconciliation: 135 derived, 135 run, 0 unrun.

Final pass, non-zero exits only:
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: unbuilt workspace dist). Both were rerun after the full build `check:type-check-debt` performed, and both exited 0.
- `check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs` failed once with `spawnSync node ETIMEDOUT` on the loaded box. Rerun: exit 0.

Fixed in this PR because a gate caught them:
- `check:route-ledger-census`: 150 to 153.
- `check:test-source-alias`: plugin-audit gets an anchored alias for plugin-hono-server, and the domain test imports `@objectstack/metadata` at module top.
- `check-affected-docs`: the runtime door table keys `pattern`, not `path`, so it is not read as a spec API declaration.
- `check:query-options-erasure`: the test's `findOne` options are typed.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The cause is in objectstack: the plugin-audit mount and the runtime dispatcher layer. Ruling A on #22438 is applied to this member of the class. The personal-views and attachments doors of the same class are not touched here; the seat files them separately.
- Clause-② `yes (widening)` adds one optional member on one new contract and one new slot key. Nothing is removed or narrowed. A service without the member still satisfies the contract (pinned).
- The `/comments` rows enter the route ledger as `server-only`, because the gap ratchet is 0. The live-mount parity boot pins them as unexercised, because that boot composes no `AuditPlugin`.
- NOT MEASURED: `route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts`. It boots the showcase app, and the box's verify lock never reached this run for that boot. CI's merge-queue dogfood shard runs it.
- Deviation: the shared verify lock answered queue-timeout (exit 99) on every attempt in about 2.5 hours, under holders that each ran 10 to 80 minutes. One build closure did acquire the lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). Per the seat's fallback, the scoped vitest and typecheck runs above ran outside the lock, one at a time. A parked slot did not keep its place across re-queues (it reappeared at the back); that is recorded for the seat.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/runtime/src/domains/comments.ts`: `handleCommentsRequest` (the three-shape claim, the 501 legs, the body-unread forward).
2. `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts`: the `init()` slot registration and the extracted `registerCommentDoors` (must equal the old inline body).
3. `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/comment-doors-member.ts`: the private never-listening table.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/http-conformance exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/hono-comment-doors.conformance.test.ts` after building the closure. Expected: 3 suites green; the unreact, resolve/reopen and own-delete legs answer 200 on a kernel with no `http.server`.
